{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out invalid age (-1) only for the mean calculation
valid_age_converted = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Compute the number of converted customers with valid age
n_valid_age = len(valid_age_converted)

# Compute the number of converted customers with age -1
n_invalid_age = len(converted_df) - n_valid_age

# Print all required numbers
print(f'mean_age: {mean_age}')
print(f'n_valid_age: {n_valid_age}')
print(f'n_invalid_age: {n_invalid_age}')"}
